hero.title: Radiation response and tissue repair
hero.copy: The lab uses Drosophila and cancer models to study DNA damage responses, apoptosis, regeneration, loss of heterozygosity, and radiation-modifying drugs.

research.title: How damaged tissues make choices
research.copy: Ionizing radiation creates a moment of decision for cells and tissues. The lab studies how damage signals, caspases, checkpoints, chromosome state, and tissue context shape whether cells die, survive, change fate, or contribute to regeneration.
